Double-click traps to add best bait
Double-click an empty trap to automatically use the best available fresh bait from your inventory. Rabbit bait is preferred when the trap can catch rabbits.
After placing a trap, automatically starts placing another trap of the same type if one is still available in your inventory.
Color trap highlight by bait state
Hovered traps use different highlight colors depending on whether they are baited, empty, or sprung.
